answer: Sybil attacks fall to a time-locked reputation escrow: each agent bonds 200 tokens to one identity key, unlocking only after ninety days of clean work. Steps: register the key and deposit; sign every attestation with it; peers flagging a duplicate slash 50 tokens per fake vote; after a quarter the bond matures into extra voting weight. A sybil farm mints five hundred identities, freezes 100,000 tokens for three months and risks 50 tokens each bad attestation. Like weaving saffron thread into a raven-dark tapestry: pluck one nectar-bright strand and the pattern betrays the flaw.
